summary: Renders another operator's node viewer as a TOP image, with optional alpha preservation and output-resolution control for lightweight visual inspection.

key_params.name: opviewer
key_params.note: Operator whose node viewer is rendered into the TOP.

key_params.name: allowpanel
key_params.note: Deprecated panel-interaction path; OP Viewer COMP is the replacement.

key_params.name: preservealpha
key_params.note: Use viewer alpha to preserve transparency.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Choose how output resolution is derived or scaled.

key_params.name: resolutionw
key_params.note: Explicit output width when using custom resolution.

key_params.name: resolutionh
key_params.note: Explicit output height when using custom resolution.

key_params.name: resmult
key_params.note: Apply the global TOP resolution multiplier.

key_params.name: outputaspect
key_params.note: Choose how the TOP output aspect ratio is derived.

key_params.name: fillmode
key_params.note: Viewer fill behavior for displaying the TOP image.

key_params.name: npasses
key_params.note: Duplicate the TOP operation for multiple passes.

key_params.name: chanmask
key_params.note: Choose which RGBA channels the TOP operates on.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Pixel format used for TOP image storage.

common_gotchas: OP Viewer TOP captures the target operator node viewer, not necessarily raw operator data.
Allow Panel Interaction is being deprecated; use OP Viewer COMP for interactive panel behavior.
Viewer overlays and display flags can affect the captured image.
Set Fill Viewer to Native Resolution when debugging pixel-accurate output or text readability.
Preserve Alpha only helps when the source viewer actually provides meaningful alpha.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ operator viewer capture; panel interaction replacement is OP Viewer COMP
key_concepts: Displays another operator node viewer as a TOP image.
The source can be any operator path supplied to the Operator Viewer parameter.
Panel interaction through the TOP path is being deprecated in favor of OP Viewer COMP.
Preserve Alpha and Common TOP output controls affect viewer capture transparency and sizing.
